etymology: Phono-semantic: 女 + 胥 (phonetic セイ→むこ) — the man who joins her family: son-in-law.
mnemonic: The groom who changes registers — むこ. 花婿: the bride's counterpart.

etymology: Compound: the name (名) cut in metal (金) — the maker's signature: inscription; taken to heart (肝に銘じる).
mnemonic: The name that outlives the namer — メイ. 銘柄: the brand on the blade or bottle.

etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 烕 'fire quenched' (phonetic メツ) — put out utterly: to perish.
mnemonic: Fire, water and blade in one verdict — ほろびる. 滅びる: empires' final verb; 全集中… the demon-slaying one too.

etymology: Pictograph: the rabbit-figure slipping the snare — let off: exemption, license (免許).
mnemonic: Out of the trap, papers stamped — メン. 免許: licensed to escape scrutiny; ごめん: your daily 免.

etymology: Phono-semantic: plants (艹) + 戊 (phonetic モ) — growth run riot: lush.
mnemonic: The garden reclaiming the path — しげる. 茂み: where the ball disappears.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 亡 (phonetic モウ) + 女 — sense gone missing: reckless fancy: delusion.
mnemonic: Reason left the building — モウ. 妄想: the fan-fiction of the mind.

etymology: Phono-semantic: beast (犭) + 孟 (phonetic モウ) — the alpha animal: ferocious.
mnemonic: The firstborn hound of the pack — モウ. 猛暑: summer, fanged.

etymology: Compound ideograph: the eye (目) lost (亡) — blind; unseeing spots (盲点).
mnemonic: Sight, absent — モウ. 盲点: where even good eyes are 盲.

etymology: Phono-semantic: thread (糸) + 罔 (phonetic モウ) — the woven mesh: net, network.
mnemonic: Thread crossed until nothing slips through — あみ. 網羅: coverage, fisherman-grade.

etymology: Phono-semantic: plow (耒) + 毛 (phonetic モウ) — worn thin as hair: to wear away.
mnemonic: Ground down to fuzz — モウ. 消耗: batteries and morale.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 黒 (phonetic モク) + 犬 — the dog that doesn't bark: silence.
mnemonic: The black dog says nothing — だまる. 沈黙: the loudest kanji pair.

etymology: Phono-semantic: thread (糸) + 文 'pattern' (phonetic モン) — the woven emblem: crest.
mnemonic: The pattern that names the clan — モン. 家紋 and 指紋: crests of house and fingertip.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 冫 (from molten flow) + 台 (phonetic ヤ) — ore melted and worked: smelting.
mnemonic: The forge where metal learns manners — ヤ. 冶金: metallurgy's kanji.

etymology: Phono-semantic: bow (弓) + a phonetic (ミ/ヤ) — stretched further: increasingly; the auspicious 弥 of 弥生.
mnemonic: Drawn a notch further each time — や. 弥生: March — spring, all the more.

etymology: Compound: pinned under the cliff — calamity: bad luck.
mnemonic: The boulder with your name on it — ヤク. 厄年: the unlucky years the shrine warns about.

etymology: Phono-semantic: foot (足) + 翟 (phonetic ヤク) — springing like a pheasant: to leap.
mnemonic: Feet with flight plans — おどる. 活躍: leaping large on the field.

etymology: Phono-semantic: tree (木) + 卯 (phonetic リュウ) — the trailing tree: willow.
mnemonic: Hair down to the river — やなぎ. 柳: the ghost story's favorite tree.

etymology: Phono-semantic: heart (忄) + 兪 (phonetic ユ) — the heart lightened: joy.
mnemonic: The heart with the day off — ユ. 愉快: fun, certified.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 疒 + 兪 (phonetic ユ) — illness carried away: to heal.
mnemonic: The sickbed emptying — いやす. 癒し: the spa industry's kanji.

etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 兪 (phonetic ユ) — guiding words: to admonish, instruct.
mnemonic: The lecture with your interests at heart — さとす. 諭吉: Fukuzawa, on the old ¥10,000.

etymology: Phono-semantic: mouth (口) + 隹 (phonetic ユイ) — the single assent: only.
mnemonic: One bird, one word — ただ. 唯一: the only one, doubly stated.

etymology: Compound: threads lost in the mountain — dim, hidden: secluded; the dim world: ghosts (幽霊).
mnemonic: Barely there between the peaks — ユウ. 幽霊: the resident of dimness.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 攸 (phonetic ユウ) + heart (心) — the heart given room: far, unhurried.
mnemonic: Time measured in horizons — ユウ. 悠々: strolling through eternity.

etymology: Pictograph: the mourner walking head-down, heart heavy — grief: melancholy.
mnemonic: The slow walk of worry — うれい. 憂鬱: the heaviest word in the mood diary.

etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 勇 (phonetic ユウ) — springing from below: to gush.
mnemonic: Courage and springs share plumbing — わく. 湧き水: the mountain's free fountain.

etymology: Originally a hesitant monkey-beast — pausing: still, yet; the granted pause: 猶予.
mnemonic: The animal that waits and watches — ユウ. 執行猶予: the suspended sentence.

etymology: Phono-semantic: garment (衤) + 谷 (phonetic ユウ) — robes with room to spare: affluence.

etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 秀 (phonetic ユウ) — drawn along by words: to invite, lure.
mnemonic: The pitch you follow outside — さそう. 誘惑: temptation with a schedule.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 厷 (phonetic ユウ) + bird (隹) — the cock bird: male; the grand: heroic (英雄).
mnemonic: The rooster posture — おす. 英雄: the hero — flower plus rooster, oddly perfect.

etymology: Phono-semantic: cauldron (鬲) + 虫 (phonetic ユウ) — melted to flowing: to fuse; flowing money: finance (金融).
mnemonic: Solid to liquid, assets included — ユウ. 金融: money in its liquid state.

etymology: Phono-semantic (simplified from 譽): lifted words (言) — acclaim: honor.
mnemonic: Your name, carried overhead — ほまれ. 名誉: the honor roll.

etymology: Compound: steady usable service (用) — ordinary, middling; employment (登庸).
mnemonic: Perfectly adequate, on schedule — ヨウ. 中庸: the golden mean.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 昜 (phonetic ヨウ) — raised high: to hoist; raised in oil: to deep-fry (唐揚げ).
mnemonic: Flags up, chicken in — あげる. 揚げ物: hoisted from the fryer.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + a phonetic (ヨウ) — rocked back and forth: to sway.
mnemonic: The train's lullaby — ゆれる. 揺れる: earthquakes and resolve.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 雍 (phonetic ヨウ) — arms around: to embrace, back (a candidate).
mnemonic: The endorsement, physically — ヨウ. 擁護: defense by embrace.

etymology: Compound: the fire-hole (穴) roasting within — the potter's kiln.
mnemonic: The cave that bakes bowls — かま. 窯元: the pottery's source.

etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + a phonetic (ヨウ) — the sung word: ballad, chant.
mnemonic: Words carried on melody — うたい. 民謡: the folk songbook.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 卬 (phonetic ヨク) — pressed down: to suppress.
mnemonic: The lid held on the pot — おさえる. 抑える: prices, tempers, sneezes.

etymology: Phono-semantic: feathers (羽) + 異 (phonetic ヨク) — the paired spans: wings.
mnemonic: 羽's full wingspan edition — つばさ. 左翼・右翼: politics borrowed both.

etymology: Compound: the bird-net of fine thread — gauze; spread out: array (羅列); phonetic ラ (羅馬).
mnemonic: The net fine enough for songbirds — ラ. 網羅 completes the sweep.

etymology: Phono-semantic: garment (衤) + 果 (phonetic ラ) — stripped to the fruit: bare.
mnemonic: The clothes left with the peel — はだか. 裸: the onsen dress code.

etymology: Compound: the storm (雨) rolling over the fields (田) — thunder.
mnemonic: The sky's drum solo over the paddies — かみなり. 雷: Pikachu's element, formally.

etymology: Phono-semantic: jar (酉) + 各 (phonetic ラク) — fermented milk: dairy.
mnemonic: The jar full of the herd's output — ラク. 酪農: Hokkaido's industry.

etymology: Compound ideograph: mountain (山) + wind (風) — the mountain gale: storm.
mnemonic: Wind with terrain advantage — あらし. 嵐: the weather and the boy band.

etymology: Phono-semantic: wood (木) + 闌 (phonetic ラン) — the railing; the ruled space: column, form field.
mnemonic: The fenced box on the form — ラン. 空欄: the blank that fails you.

etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 監 (phonetic ラン) — past the brim: to flood; excess (濫用).
mnemonic: The supervisor arrives too late — ラン. 氾濫: the river filing overtime.

etymology: Phono-semantic: plants (艹) + 監 (phonetic ラン) — the dye plant: indigo.
mnemonic: The vat that blued all of Japan — あい. 青は藍より出でて: the student surpasses the master.
